The '''Imperial Command Center''' was a command center utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during their occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Molos/Legends|Molos]]. During the [[Uprising on Molos/Legends|uprising]] on the planet, the command center was half-destroyed with [[Mine/Legends|mining]] explosives placed their by the revolting citizens.

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Command Center was mentioned in ''[[Lead by Example]]'',<ref name="LBE" /> the [[2016]]<ref name="Join the Top Ranks">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2016/2/4/join-the-top-ranks|text=Join the Top Ranks}}</ref> [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' sourcebook for the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="LBE" />
